principle: IDENTITY != SPECIES != CULTURE != CITIZENSHIP != FACTION != RANK != POSITION != PERSONALITY != CAPABILITY != CURRENT_STATE
rules: Canonical biography initializes only history before campaign start.
After campaign start, live events override any later screen-canon future.
Faction membership and citizenship are separate.
Species and culture never define personality automatically.
A character knows only information present in their knowledge state.
Capabilities change only through validated evidence, not manual point allocation.
Current condition may affect performance without rewriting deep experience.
Objectives do not grant capability or force world events.
AI dialogue cannot mutate authoritative character state directly.
